description: The versioned machine-readable output of `proofdeploy verify` (plan 1.10, WO-1.10 / D81). Prose contract: the verify section of docs/contract/result-contract.md. Every key is always present; fields that do not apply are null or empty, never absent. A stopped run (refusal, usage error, internal error) carries verdict null and its exit code; a completed run carries the fail-closed verdict and the evidence record it wrote.

cause.description: The specific run-level cause of an INCONCLUSIVE verdict (D84), a registered token: model_transport, model_overflow, author_output_invalid, leak_check, provisioning_failed, probe_inconclusive. Required and non-empty when the verdict is INCONCLUSIVE (enforced by the allOf rule); null on PASS, FAIL, and stopped runs. The cause never replaces the typed reason: governance (which class may be admin-relaxed) reads typed_reason only.

detail.description: Human-readable detail for a stop or an INCONCLUSIVE run; null when the verdict speaks for itself.

engine.description: The engine that produced the verdict, name/version (proofdeploy/<package version>). The verdict logic is the shared engine's; verify adds no verdict logic of its own beyond the registered rollup.

evidence_record.description: The evidence record this run wrote (result-contract format), or null when the run stopped before any record (refusals, usage errors, leak stops, internal errors).

exit_code.description: 0 PASS, 1 FAIL, 2 INCONCLUSIVE, 3 not supported (typed), 4 usage/config error, 5 internal error.

isolation_mode.description: The sandbox app network mode actually in effect for the provisioned side (from the record's sandbox evidence), or 'sandbox' when the side was provisioned without a reported mode. Null when nothing was provisioned.

model.description: The pinned probe-author model id. Stage 1 has no model selection (parked, O11).

probe_set_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of the parsed probe set — the same value the evidence record stores as parsed_probes_sha256. Null when no record was written.

probes.description: Every probe reported individually, in probe order — the result contract's per-probe result objects verbatim (proofdeploy.executor.ProbeResult.to_dict), including invalid author blocks (never sent, INCONCLUSIVE probe). Empty when the run stopped before execution.

record_schema_version.description: The schema_version stamped on the evidence record (the result contract's SCHEMA_VERSION). Null when no record was written.

timings.description: Wall-clock seconds per phase (bundle_s, author_s, provision_s, execute_s, total_s), rounded to milliseconds. Only the phases that ran are present.

typed_reason.description: For INCONCLUSIVE: one of the four registered reason classes only — environment, auth, drift, probe (enforced by the allOf rule): the first inconclusive probe's class, or the class of the run-level stop; the specific cause rides in `cause`, never here. For exits 3/4/5: the refusal or error, named. Null on PASS and FAIL.

verdict.description: The fail-closed verdict, or null when the run stopped before a verdict (exit 3/4/5). INCONCLUSIVE is never rendered as a pass: it has its own value and exit code.

verify_output_version.description: This output format's version. Readers refuse an unknown major (proofdeploy.versions.check_schema_version).

title: proofdeploy verify output
